title: anoda cristata var. brachyantha
intro: Anoda cristata var. brachyantha, commonly known as the prickly anoda or Mexican poppy mallow, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Anoda cristata var. brachyantha are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are present in its leaves and flowers.
